@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.catalog import add_book
+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book import load_book
+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book.load_book import (
+    author_import_record_to_author,
+    import_record_to_edition,
+)
+from openlibrary.catalog.utils import InvalidLanguage
+
+
+def test_cover_host_validation():
+    allowed = ('m.media-amazon.com',)
+    assert add_book.check_cover_url_host(
+        'https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image.jpg', allowed
+    )
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host('https://evil.example/image.jpg', allowed)
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host(None, allowed)
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host('https:///image.jpg', allowed)
+
+
+def test_renamed_conversion_functions(monkeypatch, add_languages):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(load_book, 'find_entity', lambda author: None)
+    author = author_import_record_to_author({'name': 'Mr. Smith, John'})
+    assert author['name'] == 'John Smith'
+    edition = import_record_to_edition(
+        {'title': 'Preview', 'authors': [{'name': 'Mrs. Doe, Jane'}],
+         'languages': ['ENG'], 'description': 'Text'}
+    )
+    assert edition['authors'][0]['name'] == 'Jane Doe'
+    assert edition['languages'] == [{'key': '/languages/eng'}]
+    assert edition['description'] == {'type': '/type/text', 'value': 'Text'}
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidLanguage):
+        import_record_to_edition({'languages': ['wtf']})
+
+
+def test_preview_new_book_has_edits_without_writes(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    upload = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('cover upload'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(add_book, 'add_cover', upload)
+    save = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('save_many'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', save)
+    rec = {
+        'title': 'A Preview Book',
+        'source_records': ['marc:preview'],
+        'authors': [{'name': 'Doe, Jane'}],
+        'cover': 'https://m.media-amazon.com/image.jpg',
+    }
+    result = add_book.load(rec, save=False)
+    assert result['success'] and result['preview']
+    assert result['cover_accepted'] is True
+    assert result['edition']['key'].startswith('/books/__new__')
+    assert result['work']['key'].startswith('/works/__new__')
+    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
+    assert {e['type']['key'] for e in result['edits']} == {
+        '/type/author', '/type/work', '/type/edition'
+    }
+    upload.assert_not_called()
+    save.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_preview_matched_edition_reports_modification_without_writes(
+    mock_site, monkeypatch
+):
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/works/OL30W', 'type': {'key': '/type/work'},
+        'title': 'Matched Preview',
+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/books/OL30M', 'type': {'key': '/type/edition'},
+        'title': 'Matched Preview', 'source_records': ['ia:preview'],
+        'works': [{'key': '/works/OL30W'}],
+    })
+    save = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('save_many'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', save)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        add_book, 'update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition',
+        Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('IA write')),
+    )
+    result = add_book.load({
+        'title': 'Matched Preview', 'source_records': ['ia:preview'],
+        'ocaid': 'preview', 'subjects': ['Example'],
+    }, save=False)
+    assert result['preview'] and result['success']
+    assert result['edition'] == {'key': '/books/OL30M', 'status': 'modified'}
+    assert result['work'] == {'key': '/works/OL30W', 'status': 'modified'}
+    assert {edit['key'] for edit in result['edits']} == {
+        '/books/OL30M', '/works/OL30W'
+    }
+    save.assert_not_called()

diff --git a/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_preview.py b/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_preview.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5d91ab8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_preview.py
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.catalog import add_book
+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book import load_book
+from openlibrary.catalog.add_book.load_book import (
+    author_import_record_to_author,
+    import_record_to_edition,
+)
+from openlibrary.catalog.utils import InvalidLanguage
+
+
+def test_cover_host_validation():
+    allowed = ('m.media-amazon.com',)
+    assert add_book.check_cover_url_host(
+        'https://M.MEDIA-AMAZON.COM/image.jpg', allowed
+    )
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host('https://evil.example/image.jpg', allowed)
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host(None, allowed)
+    assert not add_book.check_cover_url_host('https:///image.jpg', allowed)
+
+
+def test_renamed_conversion_functions(monkeypatch, add_languages):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(load_book, 'find_entity', lambda author: None)
+    author = author_import_record_to_author({'name': 'Mr. Smith, John'})
+    assert author['name'] == 'John Smith'
+    edition = import_record_to_edition(
+        {'title': 'Preview', 'authors': [{'name': 'Mrs. Doe, Jane'}],
+         'languages': ['ENG'], 'description': 'Text'}
+    )
+    assert edition['authors'][0]['name'] == 'Jane Doe'
+    assert edition['languages'] == [{'key': '/languages/eng'}]
+    assert edition['description'] == {'type': '/type/text', 'value': 'Text'}
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidLanguage):
+        import_record_to_edition({'languages': ['wtf']})
+
+
+def test_preview_new_book_has_edits_without_writes(mock_site, monkeypatch):
+    upload = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('cover upload'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(add_book, 'add_cover', upload)
+    save = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('save_many'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', save)
+    rec = {
+        'title': 'A Preview Book',
+        'source_records': ['marc:preview'],
+        'authors': [{'name': 'Doe, Jane'}],
+        'cover': 'https://m.media-amazon.com/image.jpg',
+    }
+    result = add_book.load(rec, save=False)
+    assert result['success'] and result['preview']
+    assert result['cover_accepted'] is True
+    assert result['edition']['key'].startswith('/books/__new__')
+    assert result['work']['key'].startswith('/works/__new__')
+    assert result['authors'][0]['key'].startswith('/authors/__new__')
+    assert {e['type']['key'] for e in result['edits']} == {
+        '/type/author', '/type/work', '/type/edition'
+    }
+    upload.assert_not_called()
+    save.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_preview_matched_edition_reports_modification_without_writes(
+    mock_site, monkeypatch
+):
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/works/OL30W', 'type': {'key': '/type/work'},
+        'title': 'Matched Preview',
+    })
+    mock_site.save({
+        'key': '/books/OL30M', 'type': {'key': '/type/edition'},
+        'title': 'Matched Preview', 'source_records': ['ia:preview'],
+        'works': [{'key': '/works/OL30W'}],
+    })
+    save = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('save_many'))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mock_site, 'save_many', save)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        add_book, 'update_ia_metadata_for_ol_edition',
+        Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('IA write')),
+    )
+    result = add_book.load({
+        'title': 'Matched Preview', 'source_records': ['ia:preview'],
+        'ocaid': 'preview', 'subjects': ['Example'],
+    }, save=False)
+    assert result['preview'] and result['success']
+    assert result['edition'] == {'key': '/books/OL30M', 'status': 'modified'}
+    assert result['work'] == {'key': '/works/OL30W', 'status': 'modified'}
+    assert {edit['key'] for edit in result['edits']} == {
+        '/books/OL30M', '/works/OL30W'
+    }
+    save.assert_not_called()
